_meta.purpose: RTL locale fixture stub for EPIC #108 Phase 2 (ar) and Phase 3 (he). Documents the metadata shape a new RTL locale must supply in languages.ts and the minimum key set for the hero/nav surfaces.
_meta.reuse: Phase 2 (ar): add { code: 'ar', label: 'العربية', dir: 'rtl' } to src/client/config/languages.ts; add a full ar.json using this stub as the nav/hero template. The styles/rtl.css file already handles [dir='rtl'] layout flips via LocaleProvider.
_meta.note: Sample strings are illustrative Arabic. Phase 2 implementers should have the full dictionary professionally reviewed before shipping.
